title_zh: 平衡模组 · 左右载荷配对
scope_en: Recorded simulator outcomes, not decoder predictions. The pair holds context and mass fixed; it illustrates a physical intervention contrast, not a model counterfactual accuracy result.
scope_zh: 这是记录的仿真结果，不是解码器预测。配对保持情境和质量一致，展示物理干预对照，不代表模型反事实准确率。
timing: Phase-based speed changes; labels describe recorded replay speed. Reading pauses remain.
